title: skillize.yaml
description: Skillize policy v1. Enable/disable named agent skills and overlay project-local when-to-use prose. Empty skills means nothing is enabled. Pin hashes stay in skills-lock.json. This file is not a skill format and not a host mounter.

$schema.description: Optional pointer at this schema so editors can validate the file.

version.description: Schema generation. Integer 1 only; do not write 1.0.

skills.description: Map of skill directory names (the folder under .agents/skills that contains SKILL.md). An empty object enables nothing. Unknown names are a load error once a checker exists.

enabled.description: When false, agentize must not compose or copy this skill even if a part or profile names it.

when.description: Project overlay: when this skill should fire in this tree. Does not rewrite the vendored SKILL.md description.
